value: Reverses the effect of the previous user operation. | Clarify the target of the undo. For example, if people just selected a menu item, you can append the item’s title, such as Undo Paste and Match Style. For a text entry operation, you might append the word *Typing* to give Undo Typing.

name: Font
value: Displays a submenu containing items for adjusting font attributes of the selected text. Standard submenus include: Show Fonts, Bold, Italic, Underline, Bigger, Smaller, Show Colors, Copy Style, and Paste Style.

name: Text
value: Displays a submenu containing items for adjusting text attributes of the selected text. Standard submenus include: Align Left, Align Center, Justify, Align Right, Writing Direction, Show Ruler, Copy Ruler, and Paste Ruler.

name: Show/Hide Tab Bar
value: Toggles the visibility of the tab bar above the body area in a tab-based window

name: Show All Tabs/Exit Tab Overview
value: Enters and exits a view (similar to Mission Control) that provides an overview of all open tabs in a tab-based window

name: Show/Hide Toolbar
value: In a window that includes a toolbar, toggles the toolbar’s visibility

name: Customize Toolbar
value: In a window that includes a toolbar, opens a view that lets people customize toolbar items

name: Show/Hide Sidebar
value: In a window that includes a sidebar, toggles the sidebar’s visibility

name: Minimize
value: Minimizes the active window to the Dock. Pressing the Option key changes this item to Minimize All.

name: Zoom
value: Toggles between a predefined size appropriate to the window’s content and the window size people set. Pressing the Option key changes this item to Zoom All. | Avoid using Zoom to enter or exit full-screen mode. The View menu supports these functions.

name: Show Previous Tab
value: Shows the tab before the current tab in a tab-based window.

name: Show Next Tab
value: Shows the tab after the current tab in a tab-based window.

name: Send *YourAppName* Feedback to Apple
value: Opens the Feedback Assistant, in which people can provide feedback.

name: *YourAppName* Help
value: When the content uses the Help Book format, opens the content in the built-in Help Viewer.

name: *Additional Item*
value: Use a separator between your primary help documentation and additional items, which might include registration information or release notes. Keep the total the number of items you list in the Help menu small to avoid overwhelming people with too many choices when they need help. Alternatively, consider linking to additional items from within your help documentation.

name: Menu bar visibility

name: Horizontal alignment

name: Menu bar extras
